ARTIFACT gap_finding: The probe list stops at P-CC-12, so the new probe is P-CC-13. Spec `plugins/tempergraph/docs/specs/executor-claude-code.spec.md`: ECC-B13 (lines 97-99) names P-CC-1 to P-CC-9, P-CC-10 and P-CC-11 are in ECC-B14 (line 105), and P-CC-12 is in ECC-B16/ECC-AC10, so it appears by id only on line 149. ECC-AC5 (line 138) covers ECC-B13 probe results. Line 149, in Open questions, reads "- Not built yet: probes P-CC-1 to P-CC-12 have not been confirmed on the owner's machine. Owner: engine owner." Runbook `plugins/tempergraph/docs/plans/live-checks.plan.md`: section 3 rows are L-0 to L-42 (columns Row|Check|Test|A pass looks like|Then update), with P-CC-1 at L-1 (line 24), P-CC-10 at L-31 (line 34) and P-CC-12 at L-42 (line 71, the last row). Section 4 Results (from line 73) uses Row|Date|CLI version|Result|Notes, L-42 is at line 118 and the trailing paragraph at line 120. P-CC-11 has no section 3 row, only a result row at line 111. Places that state the count: `engine/src/tempergraph/executors/claude.py:501` (`LIVE_FACTS` built from `range(1, 13)`, all "not run"); `engine/src/tempergraph/data/executor_compat.json:8` ("P-CC-1 to P-CC-12 not yet run"); `engine/tests/test_claude_executor.py:476` (asserts P-CC-10, 11 and 12 are "not run", so it needs P-CC-13 added); and `engine/tests/test_r3_t8_1_docs.py:36`, which asserts an Open-questions item starts with "- Not built yet: probes P-CC-1 to P-CC-12", so spec line 149 and this test must change together. `engine/tests/live/test_probes.py:180` holds the P-CC-12 live test, which is the pattern for a new live test. `engine-cli.spec.md:28` says `executors --probe` shows "P-CC-1 to P-CC-8", already stale against the code, and `r3-t1-2.handoff.md:34` left that count to the plan. Nothing named P-CC-13 or a connector probe exists. The new rule (G1 to G3) sits in ECC-B8, ECC-B9 and ECC-B10, which the new probe would confirm.
